useCase: Binary classification of real vs. generado por IA images using aprendizaje profundo características
mechanism: Utiliza a ResNet-50 backbone pre-trained on ImageNet, replacing the final classification layer with a binary real/AI classifier. Global Average Pooling aggregates spatial características before the fully connected layer. Transfer learning enables robust característica extraction from limited forense training data.
name: Clasificador Binario ResNet
source: Wang et al. (2020) - CNN-generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot For Now, CVPR
algorithm: ResNet-50 + Global Average Pooling + FC Layer
parameters: Backbone: ResNet-50, Pre-training: ImageNet, FC output: 2 (real/AI), Input: 224x224, Optimizer: Adam, Learning rate: 1e-4
description: Fine-tuned ResNet-50 deep red neuronal trained on large-scale real vs. generado por IA image datasets. Utiliza transfer learning from ImageNet for robust característica extraction.

references.title: Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-Generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot...For Now. CVPR.
He, K. et al. (2016). Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition. CVPR.

strengths:
• Strong baseline with high precisión
• Benefits from ImageNet pre-training
• Captures both low-level and high-level características
• Well-studied architecture with known properties
limitations:
• La generalización a generadores no vistos es limitada
• Requiere reentrenamiento para nuevos tipos de modelos de IA
• La naturaleza de caja negra limita la interpretabilidad
• Vulnerable a ataques adversarios
